authority: existing EngineExecutionService read authorization, SQLiteEngineSubmissionStore accepted command and SQLiteExecutionRepository canonical execution

interface.query: required actor_id and tenant_id, each 1..512 characters
interface.authorization: sealed service token, verified service principal matching the durable submission, existing server-side engine:read grant allowing original tenant and capability, exact original actor and tenant
interface.response: bounded non-content identity projection of the original durable accepted compiled context: operation/execution/turn, actor/tenant, context and handoff digests, compiler, source snapshot, data class, purpose, capability, idempotency key and trace
interface.integrity: revalidate accepted command constructors, original acknowledgement identity and idempotency digest, full canonical execution request identity and any existing checkpoint context/tenant identity before returning
interface.historical_read: expired execution delegation permits authorized historical reads under the current server-side service grant, consistent with existing status and events
interface.failure: 401 invalid token/principal header; 403 principal/grant/actor/tenant denial; 404 unknown execution; 422 malformed query or corrupt durable identity
interface.bounds: one accepted submission, one canonical execution and latest checkpoint; no context compilation, model dispatch, credentials, instructions, prompts, history, tool schemas or authority mutation

scope_limitations: read-only candidate interface in existing engine-api plane
does not alter signed gap closure evidence or authorize production model promotion
